text:
Maya Chen: quick sync 10am PT announce next Wed. need changelog link, docs anchor, short bench blurb for the hero, and the webinar signup flow wired. who can own the eng handoff?
Samira Khan: Ill draft copy. need a 1-line bench highlight + 2 tech callouts and the canonical docs URL.
Alex Rivera: Ill do changelog and publish docs. propose changelog freeze Tue 4pm PT, docs live Tue 11:59pm PT.
Jordan Patel: that timeline works for eng. PRs must be merged by freeze. will avoid internal codenames in public copy.
Evan Li: ops note: well do a staggered rollout. canary at announce, watch 90m, then ramp. will share playbook.
Linh Tran: tagging release-bot to schedule the canary when docs are live. release-bot: queue canary at announce time with 90m watch and notify #eng-oncall.
release-bot: canary scheduled for 2025-11-12T10:00:00-08:00, watch 90m, notify: #eng-oncall, #eng-sre.
Samira Khan: bench ask: can eng confirm test hardware and numbers? looking for a market-friendly rounded line we can put in the hero.
Alex Rivera: test run on a100-40GB, seq_len=2048, batch=24, warm KV cache. measured p99 down 13.4%, token cost down 19.1% vs prior baseline. raw: p99 13.37% lower, token cost 19.08% lower.
Samira Khan: marketing will round to: "~13% lower p99 latency; ~19% lower token cost." include hardware & config in appendix.
Jordan Patel: callouts: measured on sustained 2x throughput relative to baseline; small requests (<10 tokens) unchanged; quant-B profile used for cost numbers.
Samira Khan: got it. CTA for webinar: "Register for the 11/14 technical deep-dive" link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=release1823. include hidden params `lead_tier` and `account_id`.
Maya Chen: inbound routing rule: Enterprise SDR if company_size>75 OR website contains /enterprise; EDU/GOV -> Partnerships. Samira add `lead_tier` computed client-side and pass to HubSpot.
Evan Li: for the embed, eng will expose `account_id`, `inferred_region`, `plan_hint`. fieldnames: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint.
Samira Khan: will wire those. need example JSON embed for blog. Alex can you drop a small payload we can use?
Alex Rivera: sample payload for embed: ```{ "release": "v1823", "p99_reduction": "13.4%", "token_cost_reduction": "19.1%", "hw": "a100-40GB" }```
Samira Khan: perfect. marketing assets requested: 1) blog draft (hero + bench blurb + CTA) 2) 3 tweet variants 3) webinar slide with bench chart 4) embed modal html. will post drafts Mon noon for review.
Maya Chen: rollout timeline recap: Tue 16:00 changelog freeze, Tue 23:59 docs live, Wed 08:00 beta preflight email, Wed 10:00 public announce + blog + social + webinar modal.
Jordan Patel: rollout plan: t0 canary 5%, t+45m 30%, t+120m 100% if SLOs good. monitor p99, error_rate, qps. fallback: `fallback_policy: auto_swap_on_error_rate(1.35x)`.
Linh Tran: playbook link will be shared to #marketing once ready: https://redwood.ai/internal/eng-releases/canary-1823.md
Maya Chen: final asks: Alex drop final docs link here when live; Jordan share playbook link; Samira post drafts by Tue noon. also avoid internal product names in public copy.
Alex Rivera: will publish docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1823#changelog by Tue 23:50 PT and paste link.
Jordan Patel: will share canary playbook and test dashboards by Tue EOD.
Samira Khan: ack. aiming for Tue 12:00 PT drafts and will ping for signoff. :rocket:
Maya Chen: thanks team 1 will check back Tue morning for a quick pulse. :thumbsup:
